'''''Cataclysm''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It depicted the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] with [[Magma/Legends|lava]] erupting all around it, out of its [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] into [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Cataclysm'' was a painting available in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. It was added to the game in the [[2005]] expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']]. It could be used in the player's home as decoration. It was made from a schematic which comes from inserting three [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-infused items&mdash;a chemical [[Antidote/Legends|antidote]], an ammo box, and a [[Shisha/Legends|shisha]]&mdash;into the [[Chu-Gon Dar cube]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] relic capable of transmogrification through the Force. These items were looted from the corpses of the various enemies found on Mustafar. Once combined, it produces a schematic of the painting which could be used up to ten times by a Structures [[Merchant/Legends|Trader]] to make copies of the painting.<ref name="SWG" />
